title: 15-minute ORB entry-confirmation stack
research_question: Does one fixed close-confirmed, participation/trend-qualified 15-minute ORB have useful net expectancy under the existing realistic fill and exit model?
warmup_policy: History begins at 2018-05-01. Indicators warm up in place; no substitute values or entry before required history. First 20 sessions cannot satisfy all filters.
source_provenance: Local uncommitted implementation; these exact source files are fingerprinted. The base commit alone is not the tested implementation.
data_access: Only the specified exploration interval is loaded into indicators/simulation. Hashes identify source files, not permission to run their later bars.

entry_definition.opening_range: 09:30 inclusive to 09:45 exclusive, all three complete 5-minute bars required
entry_definition.close_confirmation: Completed bar close at least $0.01 beyond ORH/ORL; body fraction >= 0.5
entry_definition.relative_volume: Breakout 5-minute bar volume / arithmetic mean volume at the same exchange-local clock time over 20 prior observed regular sessions; strictly > 1.5
entry_definition.vwap: Cumulative regular-session HLC3-weighted bar VWAP; long close above / short close below; no slope rule
entry_definition.ema: First-observation seeded EMA9 and EMA20 on regular-session 5-minute closes, carried across sessions; directional fast-minus-slow spread strictly aligned and widening versus prior completed bar
entry_definition.range_atr: Inclusive 0.25 to 0.60 of Wilder daily ATR20, shifted one session; first TR seed high-minus-low
entry_definition.max_trades: One filled entry per symbol per session

execution.fill_timing: New completed-bar consumer defers actual position booking to next bar open and checks that entry bar for exits; legacy consumers unchanged
execution.portfolio_basis: Independent per-symbol simulations, not a concurrent shared-capital portfolio

analysis.selection: No folds, tuning or threshold selection
analysis.interpretation: Potential lead only; a positive mean or interval excluding zero does not establish a usable/confirmed edge. No selecting variants after viewing this result.

limitations: This is a declared interpretation of the article entry stack, not its midpoint-stop/scale-out/trailing strategy or a reproduction of its headline statistics.
Bar-based VWAP and feed-specific volume are not tick-exact consolidated market indicators.
Fixed-stack results cannot identify the separate causal contribution of individual filters.
Historical 5m/15m baselines differ in close qualification; comparisons to them are descriptive, not isolated paired effects.
